description: Vervoer- Spoorstations is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.gelderland.nl. The file shows the existing and projected railway stations in Gelderland and surrounding provinces. Projected railway stations mean that they may be constructed. The file distinguishes in NS, Contract Sector and Stations that are visited by both. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Transport railway stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2018-06-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
